description:
On the credits page a bunch of space agencies show up under Wikimedia Commons instead of where they belong.

## Reporter answers (follow-up)

Q: What source-logos id should CMSA entries route to?
A: Route to the existing 'cnsa' ID — CMSA folds into China's existing section (cnsa).

Q: What source-logos id should SpaceIL entries route to?
A: It needs its own section — the intended section id is 'spaceil'. I don't know the logo path or license summary details.

Q: What source-logos id should 'Multi-agency' entries route to?
A: Stays under the Wikimedia Commons section — do not create a new section for it.

Q: What source-logos id should CFHT entries route to?
A: Stays under the Wikimedia Commons section — do not create a new section for it.

Q: What source-logos id should EHT entries route to?
A: Stays under the Wikimedia Commons section — do not create a new section for it.

Q: Should USAF route to the existing 'us-space-force' source-logos section, or get its own 'united-states-air-force' section?
A: Route to the existing 'us-space-force' section — USAF folds into the US military space section.
